description: Bumps of `mrs_version` are proposed as pull requests and never automerged: MRS is pre-1.0, and it keeps a bbolt database and a Bleve index on the data path that nothing migrates between versions.
`versioning=semver` on the annotation in defaults/main.yml keeps the floating `latest` tag that ghcr.io/etkecc/mrs publishes alongside its releases out of the candidates.
